cohort: 1167 preterm neonates born between January 2010 and December 2020 at the 3rd Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Greece
finding: Early gestational age at delivery was the main risk factor for neonatal morbidity and mortality, while mode of delivery did not significantly impact neonatal survival.
mod_finding: Preterm neonates born via cesarean section were at higher risk of respiratory disorders compared to those born vaginally.
